lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Please provide us your email, so we can sent you a login code. Then click the Send Code button.

lines.label: enter-the-code
lines.said: We sent you a four-digit code to that address. [[slnc 300]] If you are not seeing it, check your spam folder.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: This is your dashboard. [[slnc 500]] You can return here anytime with the command + K short keys.

lines.label: find-the-business
lines.said: Type the name of a business, then select it from the dropdown list.

lines.label: the-business
lines.said: This is the business info page. [[slnc 300]] Click the lookup icon to find the stores.

lines.label: find-the-store
lines.said: Type the store name, [[slnc 300]] then select it from the dropdown list.

lines.label: the-store
lines.said: Now you are on the store details page. [[slnc 300]] Click the gear, then choose Lookup Items.

lines.label: item-list
lines.said: This is the lookup items search. [[slnc 300]] To add new item, [[slnc 300]] click the plus button.

lines.label: new-item
lines.said: Give the item a name. Then choose the collection it belongs to, and create this item.

lines.label: item-details
lines.said: Now add the item details. Add an image first. [[slnc 1000]] Then add a description, [[slnc 10000]] Add the quantity. [[slnc 3000]] And the price. [[slnc 3000]] Select the requirement. [[slnc 3000]] Then select the boot size as a variant [[slnc 2000]] and save.

lines.label: saved
lines.said: That is the item ready for the store to rent.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Back to the dashboard where you can log out or select a card option.
